specs.title: desktop board meets automated WCAG A/AA checks
Chess.com import dialog meets automated WCAG A/AA checks
display settings and promotion picker meet automated WCAG A/AA checks
reviewed move list and populated coaching meet automated WCAG A/AA checks
phone board and insights meet automated WCAG A/AA checks
populated archive results, URL error state and PGN/FEN dialogs have accessible labels and contrast
the highlighted move stays within the move-list scroll viewport
all navigation controls, keyboard shortcuts and clicked move highlight stay synchronized
legal hints, capture rings and illegal moves use real chess legality
alternative click moves and variation navigation never mutate the original game
drag moves work, variations can branch and recorded-move clicks return to game
annotation drag, right-pointer drawing, color replacement, eraser and clear cannot move pieces
two-tap arrow tool and per-position marks survive navigation without mixing with engine arrows
flip keeps board square colors, coordinates, and White-perspective evaluation orientation correct
promotion picker promotes to queen and preserves the FEN source
promotion picker promotes to rook and preserves the FEN source
promotion picker promotes to bishop and preserves the FEN source
promotion picker promotes to knight and preserves the FEN source
canceling promotion leaves the position untouched
castling moves king and rook and en-passant removes the passed pawn
check/checkmate, last-move highlights and recorded clocks display from real game metadata
autoplay uses selectable speeds, pauses on board interaction and restarts at the end
keyboard square selection, Escape cancellation and focus mode remain operable
FEN/PGN clipboard and download preserve exact source, including original comments
invalid import shows feedback without deleting the current game; PGN file upload works
settings persist separately from transient games and respect reduced motion
help dialog traps focus and restores focus to the invoking control
username archives, month/format filters and selected game import start an actual local review
game URL plus username/month finds exactly the requested live game in the shared picker
URL-only lookup uses metadata but still requires the exact game in public archives
URL-only fallback asks for a player without deleting the existing game
Chess.com HTTP 404 remains a recoverable import error
Chess.com HTTP 429 remains a recoverable import error
Chess.com HTTP 503 remains a recoverable import error
Cancel ignores late results; closing the presentation preserves the search without auto-importing
invalid username, non-Chess.com link and nonexistent game show meaningful feedback
F01 Lichess history picker preserves PGN/clocks and starts real local review only after selection
F01 exact public game ID is checked before explicit picker import
F01 Lichess HTTP 404 leaves the existing game intact
F01 Lichess HTTP 429 leaves the existing game intact
F01 Lichess HTTP 503 leaves the existing game intact
F01 explicit Cancel and provider switches reject stale work from either provider
F01 bounded load-more deduplicates overlap and retains earlier results after a truncated batch
F01 ongoing direct games never replace the board
F01 variant direct games never replace the board
F01 wrong ID direct games never replace the board
phone tap-to-move, hints, Return to game and all workspace tabs work
real browser touch dragging moves pieces without creating annotations
touch annotation mode, two-tap arrows, highlights and eraser lock piece moves
touch promotion picker and expanded navigation remain accessible
phone review, player coaching and engine continuation navigation are functional
320px, phone landscape and tablet layouts have no horizontal overflow
F02 detected name/ECO belongs to the recorded game and survives a different analysis branch
F02 PGN headers override local detection and FEN-only positions are explicit unavailable
F02 local opening lookup works with Internet access disabled after loading its local bundle
F02 delayed local data does not block the board/engine and cannot overwrite newer supplied metadata
F02 local dataset failure shows unavailable while board navigation remains usable
L02 compact desktop shell, exact theme tokens and unchanged native engine
L02 responsive theme has no overflow and preserves visible mobile import/settings
L02 saved palettes migrate without changing board state, annotations, original PGN or worker/search identity
L02 every classification stays legible on yellow selected moves
